steps.summary: Run straight North-West along the bridge channels into Highgate (Act 4 Town)
steps.layout_tell: 100% linear bridge; cross side bridges whenever a gate blocks the current channel.
steps.next_exit: Enter Highgate → Exit West into The Dried Lake
steps.portal_tip: Great XP density if underlevelled (target Lvl 31–33)

actions.text: Run straight NW along the aqueduct channels
Enter Highgate → Exit bottom-left to The Dried Lake

variants.title: Parallel Channels
variants.desc: Cross short bridges between left and right lanes.

steps.summary: Act 4 Town Hub → Exit South-West (bottom-left) to The Dried Lake first → Open North Mines later
steps.layout_tell: Highgate has 2 exits: SW (bottom-left) = The Dried Lake (go here 1st for Deshret's Banner); North (top) = The Mines Level 1 (unlocked by using Deshret's Banner on the seal).
steps.next_exit: Take SW Exit → Enter The Dried Lake
steps.portal_tip: After killing Voll in The Dried Lake, return to Highgate and click the Deshret Seal at the North gate!

actions.text: 1st Route: Exit South-West (bottom-left) into The Dried Lake
2nd Route (with Deshret's Banner): Open Seal at North gate → Enter The Mines Level 1

steps.boss_info: Safe Town Hub (Oyun, Petarus & Vanja, Tasuni, Kira, Dialla).
steps.gem_reward: Completing The Eternal Nightmare unlocks Level 38 Multistrike, Spell Echo, Cast when Damage Taken, and Golems.

variants.title: 2-Exit Town Hub
variants.desc: SW = Dried Lake (1st), N = The Mines Level 1 (2nd).

steps.summary: Loop around perimeter to find Voll's Camp → Kill Voll & loot Deshret's Banner → Logout to Highgate
steps.layout_tell: Voll's wooden barricade camp always spawns along one of the outer walls opposite the entrance.
steps.next_exit: Kill Voll → Loot Deshret's Banner → Logout → Open Deshret's Seal in Highgate
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ LOGOUT after picking up Deshret's Banner → Open Seal in Town → Enter The Mines!

actions.text: Search outer perimeter for Voll, Emperor of Purity
Kill Voll & pick up Deshret's Banner
Relog to Highgate → Click Deshret's Seal → Enter The Mines

steps.boss_info: Voll, Emperor of Purity: Telegraph wind-up Physical Slam + Charge.
steps.gem_reward: Breaking the Seal (Oyun): Unlocks Lvl 34 Golem Gems!

variants.title: Square Perimeter
variants.desc: Hug left or right wall until you see wooden banners.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural desert loop: Voll's camp spawns along one of the outer perimeter walls

steps.summary: Follow mine tracks heading generally North / North-West to the Level 2 stairs
steps.layout_tell: Follow main minecart tracks upward; skip dead-end side rooms.
steps.portal_tip: No Waypoint here — keep pushing to Crystal Veins

actions.text: Follow main mine shafts North/North-West
Enter The Mines Level 2

steps.boss_info: Pocked Lanternbearers: High Fire damage in tight corridors.

variants.title: Northward Tracks
variants.desc: Exit is always along the northern wall.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural mine: General direction is North/NW, but tunnel branches vary by seed

steps.summary: Find & click Deshret's Spirit (+1 Skill Point!) → Continue North/North-East to The Crystal Veins
steps.layout_tell: Deshret's Spirit is marked by a quest icon as soon as you get within 2 screens of her central alcove.
steps.next_exit: Click Deshret's Spirit (+1 Pt) → Enter The Crystal Veins
steps.portal_tip: Never leave Mines Level 2 without freeing Deshret's Spirit (+1 Passive Point)!

actions.text: Locate & click Deshret's Spirit (+1 Passive Skill Point!)
Continue North into The Crystal Veins

steps.boss_info: Corrupted spirits spawn briefly when freeing Deshret.
steps.gem_reward: An Indomitable Spirit (Tasuni in Highgate): Book of Skill (+1 Passive Skill Point)!

variants.title: Central Spirit Alcove
variants.desc: Spirit spawns mid-zone before the Crystal Veins stairs.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural mine: Deshret's Spirit (+1 Skill Pt) spawns in a side room before Crystal Veins

steps.summary: Navigate caverns North-West to Lady Dialla → TAG WAYPOINT → Enter Daresso's Dream & Kaom's Dream
steps.layout_tell: Keep heading North-West/North-East away from the entrance until you reach Lady Dialla's circular hub room.
steps.next_exit: Tag Crystal Veins WP → Enter Daresso's Dream (Right) & Kaom's Dream (Left)
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ Tag the Crystal Veins Waypoint so you can teleport right back after Daresso and Kaom!

actions.text: Reach Lady Dialla at the end of the zone & TAG WAYPOINT
Enter Daresso's Dream portal first (or Kaom's Dream)

steps.gem_reward: Tagging WP + talking to Dialla prepares the 2 Dream portals.

variants.title: Dialla Hub at End
variants.desc: WP and both Dream portals are at the far end of the zone.

steps.summary: Navigate prison cells to Barkhul pit fight → Enter The Grand Arena
steps.layout_tell: In Daresso's Dream, head North-East through the gated pit arenas until you defeat Barkhul.
steps.next_exit: Defeat Barkhul → Enter The Grand Arena
steps.portal_tip: Stand near the gate after killing Barkhul so you can exit immediately

actions.text: Run NE through the buildings into the pit cage
Defeat Barkhul & his pit waves → Enter The Grand Arena

variants.title: NE Pit Route
variants.desc: Always exits top-right after the Barkhul cage fight.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural pit rooms: Locked arena cages block progress until cleared

steps.summary: Tag Waypoint → Hop across circular arenas (always take the TOP-RIGHT bridge!) → Kill Daresso
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ ARENA TELL: In every circular arena, the correct exit bridge is ALWAYS at the Top-Right (North-East)!
steps.next_exit: Kill Daresso, King of Swords → Loot Eye of Desire → Logout → WP to Crystal Veins
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ LOGOUT after looting The Eye of Desire → Take WP to Crystal Veins → Enter Kaom's Dream!

actions.text: Cross 3 circular arenas by always taking the Top-Right (NE) exit
Kill Daresso, King of Swords & pick up The Eye of Desire
Logout to Town → Take WP to Crystal Veins → Enter Kaom's Dream

steps.boss_info: Daresso, King of Swords: Physical/Cold sword flurries. Do NOT stand inside the spinning blade rings!
steps.gem_reward: Drops The Eye of Desire (1 of 2 keys for Belly of the Beast).

variants.title: NE Bridge Rule
variants.desc: Every single arena ring exits to the North-East.

steps.summary: Always walk UPHILL along the volcanic ridges & bridges → Enter Kaom's Stronghold
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ ELEVATION TELL: Whenever the path splits, always take the stairs/ramp going UPHILL!
steps.portal_tip: Movement skills (Leap Slam / Frostblink) can jump across several lava gaps!

actions.text: Follow the rising volcanic cliffs uphill
Cross the final bridge into Kaom's Stronghold

steps.boss_info: Torchoak Grove (Unique Totem): Casts righteous fire / totems; run past.

variants.title: Uphill Lava Cliffs
variants.desc: Follow higher ground to the Stronghold gate.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural volcanic ridge: Always climb uphill toward the upper-center/NE exit

steps.summary: Tag Waypoint → Climb straight North up the narrow cliff path → Kill King Kaom → Logout to Crystal Veins
steps.layout_tell: Linear upward path from the Waypoint straight into the Caldera of the King.
steps.next_exit: Kill King Kaom → Loot Eye of Fury → Logout → Take WP to Crystal Veins
steps.portal_tip: ⚡ LOGOUT after looting The Eye of Fury → Take WP to Crystal Veins → Give both Eyes to Dialla!

actions.text: Tag WP & climb the narrow volcanic ridge North
Kill King Kaom in the Caldera & loot The Eye of Fury
Relog to Town → Claim +1 Pt & Lvl 38 Gems → WP to Crystal Veins

steps.boss_info: King Kaom: Heavy Fire Slams, Leap Slam & SR totems. Keep moving around the outer ring!
steps.gem_reward: Opening Belly of the Beast next unlocks Level 38 Support Gems (Spell Echo, Multistrike, GMP, CWDT, Unleash)!

variants.title: Linear North Climb
variants.desc: Caldera entrance is always at the top of the zone.

steps.zone_name: The Belly of the Beast Level 1
steps.summary: Run North-West through Belly Level 1 & Level 2 → Kill Piety in The Bowels of the Beast → Enter The Harvest
steps.layout_tell: Both Belly Level 1 and Level 2 trend generally North-West; follow the main flesh arteries.
steps.next_exit: Kill Piety, the Abomination → Enter The Harvest
steps.portal_tip: In Piety's fight, run in a circle around her to dodge the rotating red bleeding beam!

actions.text: Navigate NW through Belly Level 1 into Belly Level 2
In Level 2, kill Piety (circle around her rotating laser beam!)
Talk to Piety & enter The Harvest

steps.boss_info: Piety, the Abomination: Rotating beam applies massive Bleed/Corrupting Blood stacks instantly — never cross the beam!

variants.title: NW Flesh Tunnels
variants.desc: Keep moving toward the top-left in both levels.

topology.procedural_note: Procedural organic tunnels: Winds generally NW/NE through Level 1 & Level 2 to Piety

zone_aliases: The Belly of the Beast Level 2

steps.summary: Tag Waypoint → Kill 1 Guardian on LEFT & 2 Guardians on RIGHT → Give 3 Organs to Piety → Kill Malachai
steps.layout_tell: ⚡ HARVEST RULE: There is ALWAYS 1 Guardian on one side of the Waypoint and 2 Guardians on the other side!
steps.next_exit: Kill Malachai (2 Phases) → Relog to Highgate → Exit NE into The Ascent (Act 5)
steps.portal_tip: After killing the 1st Guardian on the left, take your portal or WP back to the center to do the 2 on the right!

actions.text: Tag The Harvest Waypoint right next to Piety
Kill Doedre, Maligaro & Shavronne (Left & Right wings) for 3 Organs
Enter The Black Core → Kill Malachai → Relog & take The Ascent to Act 5

steps.boss_info: Malachai, The Nightmare: Destroy the 3 Heart phases when Malachai becomes immune; dodge red teleport slam.
steps.gem_reward: Completes Act 4; The Ascent leads into Act 5 (The Slave Pens).

variants.title: Symmetric Organ Wings
variants.desc: West wing = 1 Boss; East wing = 2 Bosses.
